name: PubMed
method: Date-bounded searches with a dedicated core pass for blood and CSF biomarkers; amyloid, tau and FDG PET; p-tau species; Aβ42/40; GFAP and NfL; assay comparison, preanalytics, cutoffs, gray zones, prevalence and comorbidity effects; Centiloid/SUVR, tracer comparability, visual reads, structured reporting, concordance, discordance, reflex workflows, treatment eligibility and monitoring. A separate secondary pass covers pivotal treatment, safety, guidance and practice-changing management evidence. Screen reviews and practice standards as well as original studies; deduplicate by PMID and DOI.

name: Crossref
method: First-online date and DOI verification; early-view/final-version deduplication.

name: Neurology and dementia journals
method: Current/early-view searches across Alzheimer’s & Dementia, JAMA family, Lancet family, Nature family, Brain, Neurology, geriatric and psychiatric care journals. Include general AD trials, guidelines, safety and management outcomes independently of biomarker implications.

name: Laboratory medicine and diagnostics journals
method: Analytical validation, precision, interference, specimen matrix, tube and processing effects, freeze-thaw stability, standardization, platform transferability, head-to-head assay studies, two-cutoff workflows, predictive values, comorbidity effects, and laboratory implementation searches across Clinical Chemistry, JALM and related diagnostics journals.

name: Nuclear medicine and neuroimaging journals
method: Dedicated searches across Journal of Nuclear Medicine, Journal of Nuclear Medicine Technology, European Journal of Nuclear Medicine and Molecular Imaging, Seminars in Nuclear Medicine, Radiology, and Clinical Nuclear Medicine for amyloid, tau and relevant FDG PET; radiotracers; acquisition and quality control; visual reads and reader agreement; structured reporting; Centiloid/SUVR and reference regions; tracer harmonization; treatment eligibility and monitoring; practice parameters, procedure standards, appropriate-use criteria, and implementation reviews.

name: Health-economics journals
method: Cost-effectiveness, access, capacity, and patient-burden searches.

name: FDA 510(k) database
method: SET product code, manufacturer, device-name, and decision-date searches.

name: FDA recalls
method: Device and manufacturer searches; companion records linked and deduplicated.

name: FDA drug approvals and labels
method: PET tracers plus AD disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies, indications, initiation/maintenance dosing, ARIA and other safety changes; verify regulator documents, separate availability and coverage.

name: CMS
method: AD and dementia care, treatments and diagnostics: national coverage, GUIDE and care-planning changes, transmittals, fee schedules and public payment files; a model launch or page timestamp alone is not new evidence.

name: Medicare Coverage Database and MACs
method: NCD/LCD/article searches plus contractor policy checks.

name: Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule
method: National limit amount and gapfill/crosswalk status; never treated as coverage.

name: Major private-payer policies
method: Anthem, UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Cigna, and major BCBS policy searches; contract caveats retained.

name: Professional guidelines and consensus
method: Alzheimer’s Association, AAN, SNMMI, EANM, ACR, ACNM, ASNR, ADLM, CAP, EAN, WHO, NICE and relevant geriatric/psychiatric societies. Give priority to blood/CSF biomarker guidance, amyloid/tau/FDG PET appropriate-use criteria, procedure standards, acquisition/reading/reporting guidance, diagnosis, staging, treatment eligibility and monitoring. Also screen practice-changing safety, symptoms, caregiver and supportive-care guidance. Distinguish formal CPGs, practice parameters, procedure standards, AURs, consensus and draft versus final guidance.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov
method: New and updated AD trials of disease-modifying and symptomatic treatments, nonpharmacologic and caregiver interventions, and biomarker eligibility/endpoints; link results to definitive publications and stable trial identifiers. Registry-only results and enrollment notices are exceptional inclusions and require material field, practice, access, or trial-design relevance plus enough public detail for a useful brief.

name: AAIC
method: Abstract and release screening; peer-reviewed versions preferred and duplicates merged.

name: CTAD
method: AD treatment, safety, biomarker and implementation abstracts; match meeting dates to the review window and prefer definitive publications.

name: AD/PD
method: AD treatment, safety and biomarker abstracts and official program; definitive papers preferred.

name: Diagnostic, laboratory, imaging, and pharmaceutical organizations
method: Material public announcements only; manufacturer-only claims labeled and independently checked where possible.

name: WHO dementia guidelines
method: Risk reduction and dementia care guidance; identify populations, recommendation strength and evidence certainty where reported; distinguish prevention from treatment of established AD.

name: Cochrane dementia evidence
method: Material AD treatment and care systematic reviews; record study search cutoff, applicability, certainty, absolute benefits/harms and substantive published methodological critiques.
